mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.case_number AS `caseNumber`,r.real_name AS `realName`,r.gender,r.age,r.noon, r.visit_date AS `visitDate`,r.visit_state AS `visitState`, COALESCE(qs.queue_state,'waiting') AS `queueState` FROM register r LEFT JOIN outpatient_queue qs ON qs.register_id=r.id ORDER BY r.visit_date,r.id LIMIT #{q.offset},#{q.size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outpatient_queue(register_id,queue_state,updated_by,updated_at) VALUES(#{registerId},#{state},#{operatorId},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE queue_state=#{state},updated_by=#{operatorId},updated_at=NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE medical_record SET readme=#{readme},present=#{present},present_treat=#{presentTreat},history=#{history}, allergy=#{allergy},physique=#{physique},proposal=#{proposal},careful=#{careful},diagnosis=#{diagnosis},cure=#{cure}, diagnosis_state=#{diagnosisState},updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=NOW(),version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT disease_id FROM medical_record_disease WHERE medical_record_id=#{recordId} ORDER BY disease_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disease WHERE id=#{diseaseId}
SELECT version,content,operator_id AS `operatorId`,create_time AS `createTime` FROM medical_record_revision WHERE medical_record_id=#{recordId} ORDER BY version DESC

choose.when: SELECT a.id,a.register_id AS `registerId`,a.medical_technology_id AS `medicalTechnologyId`, a.check_info AS info,a.check_position AS position,a.check_state AS state,a.check_result AS result, a.creation_time AS `creationTime`,a.check_time AS `executionTime`,mt.tech_name AS `techName`,'check' AS kind FROM check_request a JOIN medical_technology mt ON mt.id=a.medical_technology_id WHERE a.id=#{id}

SELECT a.id,a.register_id AS `registerId`,a.medical_technology_id AS `medicalTechnologyId`, a.inspection_info AS info,a.inspection_position AS position,a.inspection_state AS state,a.inspection_result AS result, a.creation_time AS `creationTime`,a.inspection_time AS `executionTime`,mt.tech_name AS `techName`,'inspection' AS kind FROM inspection_request a JOIN medical_technology mt ON mt.id=a.medical_technology_id WHERE a.id=#{id}

SELECT a.id,a.register_id AS `registerId`,a.medical_technology_id AS `medicalTechnologyId`, a.disposal_info AS info,a.disposal_position AS position,a.disposal_state AS state,a.disposal_result AS result, a.creation_time AS `creationTime`,a.disposal_time AS `executionTime`,mt.tech_name AS `techName`,'disposal' AS kind FROM disposal_request a JOIN medical_technology mt ON mt.id=a.medical_technology_id WHERE a.id=#{id}

mapper.select: SELECT a.id,a.register_id AS `registerId`,mt.tech_name AS `techName`,'check' AS kind, a.check_info AS info,a.check_position AS position,a.check_state AS state,a.check_result AS result, a.creation_time AS `creationTime`,a.check_time AS `executionTime` FROM check_request a JOIN medical_technology mt ON mt.id=a.medical_technology_id WHERE a.register_id=#{registerId} UNION ALL SELECT a.id,a.register_id AS `registerId`,mt.tech_name AS `techName`,'inspection' AS kind, a.inspection_info AS info,a.inspection_position AS position,a.inspection_state AS state,a.inspection_result AS result, a.creation_time AS `creationTime`,a.inspection_time AS `executionTime` FROM inspection_request a JOIN medical_technology mt ON mt.id=a.medical_technology_id WHERE a.register_id=#{registerId} UNION ALL SELECT a.id,a.register_id AS `registerId`,mt.tech_name AS `techName`,'disposal' AS kind, a.disposal_info AS info,a.disposal_position AS position,a.disposal_state AS state,a.disposal_result AS result, a.creation_time AS `creationTime`,a.disposal_time AS `executionTime` FROM disposal_request a JOIN medical_technology mt ON mt.id=a.medical_technology_id WHERE a.register_id=#{registerId} ORDER BY `creationTime` DESC

choose.when: UPDATE check_request SET check_state='4' WHERE id=#{id} AND check_state='1'
UPDATE inspection_request SET inspection_state='4' WHERE id=#{id} AND inspection_state='1'
UPDATE disposal_request SET disposal_state='4' WHERE id=#{id} AND disposal_state='1'

mapper.select: SELECT id,item_type AS `itemType`,item_id AS `itemId`,fee_type AS `feeType`, fee_amount AS `feeAmount`,fee_method AS `feeMethod`,create_time AS `createTime` FROM fee_record WHERE register_id=#{registerId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT p.id,'处方' AS `itemType`,d.drug_name AS `itemName`,p.drug_state AS state, COALESCE(p.unit_price,d.drug_price)*CAST(p.drug_number AS DECIMAL(10,0)) AS amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fee_type='收费' THEN f.fee_amount ELSE -f.fee_amount END),0) FROM fee_record f WHERE f.register_id=p.register_id AND f.item_type='处方' AND f.item_id=p.id) AS `paidAmount` FROM prescription p JOIN drug_info d ON d.id=p.drug_id WHERE p.register_id=#{registerId} UNION ALL SELECT a.id,'检查' AS `itemType`,m.tech_name AS `itemName`,a.check_state AS state,m.tech_price AS amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fee_type='收费' THEN f.fee_amount ELSE -f.fee_amount END),0) FROM fee_record f WHERE f.register_id=a.register_id AND f.item_type='检查' AND f.item_id=a.id) AS `paidAmount` FROM check_request a JOIN medical_technology m ON m.id=a.medical_technology_id WHERE a.register_id=#{registerId} UNION ALL SELECT a.id,'检验' AS `itemType`,m.tech_name AS `itemName`,a.inspection_state AS state,m.tech_price AS amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fee_type='收费' THEN f.fee_amount ELSE -f.fee_amount END),0) FROM fee_record f WHERE f.register_id=a.register_id AND f.item_type='检验' AND f.item_id=a.id) AS `paidAmount` FROM inspection_request a JOIN medical_technology m ON m.id=a.medical_technology_id WHERE a.register_id=#{registerId} UNION ALL SELECT a.id,'处置' AS `itemType`,m.tech_name AS `itemName`,a.disposal_state AS state,m.tech_price AS amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.fee_type='收费' THEN f.fee_amount ELSE -f.fee_amount END),0) FROM fee_record f WHERE f.register_id=a.register_id AND f.item_type='处置' AND f.item_id=a.id) AS `paidAmount` FROM disposal_request a JOIN medical_technology m ON m.id=a.medical_technology_id WHERE a.register_id=#{registerId}
